name: comp-439
title: Badged Count Tabs
description: A row of three tabs, each a small pale number circle over a short label, where the chosen tab gains a soft rounded panel and changes the note beneath.
use: Choosing between a few inbox or dashboard sections where each total should be readable at a glance.
avoid: When counts are live: the three numbers and captions are hardcoded, not bound to real data.
a11y: Each tab reads as its number plus label to screen readers; the circles carry no extra description and there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three equal columns stretch across a dark strip, each holding a small grey circle with a count above a short label. The selected column is wrapped in a soft rounded rectangle; a centred muted caption sits below the row.
behaves: Clicking a column slides the rounded panel onto it and swaps the caption underneath. The count circles of the other tabs fade to about half opacity.
customise: Counts, labels and captions are written inside the file, so changing them means editing the tabs. The selected panel colour and circle size come from classes.
weight: light: Three labelled tabs and tiny badges; only opacity and background transitions run.
